instructions: Each test exercises the classifier on copy that was NOT in vernacular_exemplars.json. Difficulty levels: 'paraphrase' = same idea as an exemplar but reworded; 'spelling_trick' = deliberate misspelling or leet-speak to evade keyword filters; 'mixed_script' = Roman+Devanagari/Tamil mid-sentence; 'needs_ai' = only an LLM can resolve context (Layer 3); 'safe_lookalike' = shares vocabulary with a violation but is actually legitimate. Run after normalisation. For evaluation: Layer 1 = exemplar similarity, Layer 2 = concept-group word matching, ai_only = requires online LLM, none = safe (should produce no finding).
